name: Ethereum address poisoning scam
rootCause: On 2024-05-03, an Ethereum address-poisoning scam caused a transfer of 1,155 WBTC, about $68 million, to a look-alike address. The checked on-chain record in this report captures a later 51 ETH transfer linked to post-incident negotiation, while the original theft transaction remains unverified here. Address poisoning on Ethereum. Public reporting says the attacker seeded a look-alike address into the victim's recent activity, but the checked record here does not independently establish the exact bait transaction or the victim's copy step.
